54e84f877ecf6fe1002d484bdf32634d394bc293.summary: ReliaQuest reports on Scattered Spider, an English-speaking collective it says works as an affiliate of the RansomHub ransomware group. In an October 2024 manufacturing-sector intrusion, the attacker social-engineered the help desk twice, reached ESXi through a privileged account, created a VM to avoid endpoint detection, and encrypted systems within six hours. The report also covers RansomHub's rise, its 90/10 affiliate profit split, English-speaking callers used by ransomware affiliates, and defensive recommendations.

hedges: The attribution of the October 2024 incident to Scattered Spider is stated with high confidence.
The assessment that multiple individuals facilitated the attack is made with high confidence.
Scattered Spider's affiliation with RansomHub is suggested by the deployment of tactics typical of the group.
Use of cellular hotspots is assessed with medium confidence.
It is unclear why the Verizon IPv4 addresses appeared initially in the logs.
The report theorises that EDR did not alert because the events occurred at the hypervisor level.
The NTDS.dit sequence of events is a hypothesised narrative formed from the available facts.
Russia-linked involvement is described as likely, not confirmed.
